paragraphs.text: Evolver for DeepSeek Harness, by EvoMap: a harness that gets smarter the more you use it. Recalls a
proven strategy before each prompt, grades it on evidence (checks run, edits kept, your next reply),
and reports back to the EvoMap network so what works gets reused and what fails
Evolver for DeepSeek Harness
By EvoMap · English · 简体中文
**A harness that gets smarter the more you use it.**
Most agents have goldfish memory. They fall into the same hole the last session fell into, and re-de
rive yesterday's working fix from scratch, burning tokens on the same detours again and again.
Evolver lets your dsh agent evolve itself. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every
failure becomes a warning.
- **Each prompt starts with a proven strategy.** Evolver recalls the one that best fits the task fro
m your local history and the EvoMap network and hands it to the agent. No digging through old sessio

ns.
- **Graded on evidence, not a hunch.** After the turn, Evolver looks at whether the agent ran a
test, build, lint or type check and whether the last one passed; whether the next session kept or re

verted the turn's edits; and whether your next reply pushed back or approved.
- **Survival of the fi
ttest.** Every verdict goes back to the EvoMap network with its evidence tier, and the network weigh

s it by that evidence. Strategies that work get recalled more often; ones proven wrong sink.
- **One
agent's mistake, every agent's detour.** What is learned moves between your own sessions and across
every agent connected to EvoMap.
[该节后续省略]

## Connect the EvoMap network (optional)

Local memory works without an account. Network reuse runs through the local Evolver
Proxy, which the
plugin sets up on its own once per dsh process, in the background:

- `evolver` missing, or older than 2.0.39: it runs `npm install -g @evomap/evolver@latest`,
then `ev

olver lifecycle start` (or `restart` after an upgrade).
- `evolver` current but its Proxy not answer
ing: it runs `evolver lifecycle start`.

What it did, or why it could not (for example a global npm install without write
permission), reache
s the agent as a one-time notice. To finish connecting:

1. Open the claim link the Proxy writes to `~/.evomap/claim_url` while signed in to
evomap.ai.
2. Ru
n `/evolver-status` in dsh to confirm the Proxy and node.

Network recall needs `@evomap/evolver` 2.0.39 or newer. The evidence on reuse reports
reaches the Hu

b only through a Proxy newer than 2.0.42; an older one drops it, and the Hub
counts those reports as

h a Proxy newer than 2.0.42; an older one drops it, and the Hub
counts those reports as unevidenced.
## Session-end distillation

A turn that ended completed, used tools and passed its last check leaves a candidate in
`~/.evolver/

state/distill-pending.json`, a turn that reused an injected strategy too (the engine's intake
drops

a Gene that repeats one it already has); a later verified turn replaces it, and a next prompt that
r

eads as a correction drops it. When the session ends, one call to the session's own model writes a
G
ene from a digest of that turn (task, commands, touched paths, checks, final answer — never the whol

e
history) and sends it to the Proxy's `POST /conversation/distill` with `persist: true`, `publish:

false`
and its own token cost as `distill_usage`. Keys and tokens are stripped from the candidate fi

rst, paths and
a manual focus included. A candidate stays on disk until it is distilled (three faile

d tries give it up);
one whose session is over — ended with a failed try, or killed with its dsh pro

cess — is claimed by the next
session that starts, one process at a time, while an idle session keep

s its own. `/evolver-distill` does the
same at once.
## Reuse reports

Every strategy injected into a turn is reported through the Proxy's
`POST /asset/reuse-result` as `{

asset_id, outcome, task_id, reason, evidence}`. The Hub
weighs each report by its evidence:
| Report | When | `task_id` | `evidence` |
| Turn end | the turn ends | `dsh:<session>:<turn>` | `tier` `L1` when the turn ran a test, build, l
int or type check, else `none`; `applied: used`; `check` `{kind, passed, fail_then_pass}` of the las

t check; `aborted`; `stage: immediate` |
| Correction | the next prompt says the answer did not hold

, or approves it | `…:correction` | `tier: L3`, `applied: used`, `stage: correction` |
| Retention |
the next session in the same project finds the turn's edits kept or reverted | `…:retention` | `tie

r: L2`, `applied: used`, `stage: retention` |
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
Settings and their defaults are in `src/config.js`.
